title: Correct demonstrator truth and navigation semantics
trigger: Authorized actor initiates ResolveSurfaceState in SC-03, SC-07, SC-12; task story: As enterprise owner, I want to distinguish examples, actual records and unavailable data so I can assess the product honestly.
observableOutcome: Satisfy the unchanged source acceptance for T-02; primary boundary ResolveSurfaceState reaches resolved only after actual domain validation. Acknowledged jobs are not completed work.
author: codex
independentReview: Pending real independent review; no review, dependency proof or product execution is asserted.

sourceRequirements.scenario: Given empty storage and disabled execution, the UI shows zero actual runs and unavailable execution; no sample run is labelled completed or live.
Given API 503 or stale data, each affected widget shows unavailable or timestamped stale state with retry; counts never fall back to fabricated successes.
Given an example action, its label says Preview or View specification; product gate status comes from the canonical ledger and sample coverage displays its sample source.

ownership: Tenant/identity, command, persistence, job, effect, artifact and projection infrastructure; no duplicate domain semantics.
recordMeaning: surface_state is a boundary payload/result view, not permission to create an independent authoritative store. Resolve its fields into the canonical aggregate family in A-05/C-01.

openDecisions.decision: Review this primary boundary against every original scenario; author concrete domain datasets and independent output oracles, not assertions derived from the implementation.
openDecisions.closure: Approved bounded slices with executable negative/recovery fixtures for T-02-AC1, T-02-AC2, T-02-AC3 and a legitimate independent review receipt.

operations.permission: platform.ResolveSurfaceState: authenticated scoped membership plus current action grant; viewer may query authorized metadata only. Visible resource denial is 403; hidden or foreign resource is indistinguishable 404. No UI role selector or payload actor grants authority.
operations.exampleMeaning: Reserved synthetic IDs; digest strings are hashes of fixture labels, not claims about real artifacts. Missing referenced records must fail validation.
operations.acknowledgement: Return only computed/readback result; never a static success sample.

permissionRule: platform.ResolveSurfaceState: authenticated scoped membership plus current action grant; viewer may query authorized metadata only. Visible resource denial is 403; hidden or foreign resource is indistinguishable 404. No UI role selector or payload actor grants authority.
transactionBoundary: No authoritative domain mutation. Use authorized existing read paths; local preferences are not business facts. Diagnostics emit test artifacts, not product acceptance.
idempotencyRule: Repeat reads without domain writes; cancel older UI request results so they cannot overwrite a newer selection.
invalidationRule: Use CHANGE-PROTOCOL dependency kinds/field paths. Semantic accepted publication atomically advances the authoritative invalidation generation. A view-only change does not invalidate evidence. Projection lag is visible; protected effects revalidate current identity/policy/context/cell epoch.
migrationRecovery: Retain existing URL/selection and readable legacy data. Failed refresh cannot erase last-known data or relabel it fresh. No database migration in this boundary.

ui.keyboard: Tab reaches all controls in reading order; visible focus, labeled errors, focus first invalid field. Escape closes dialog and restores trigger focus; graph has list/table alternative.
